title: Title & Registration Services Schedule of the Lien Notation Charge on a Late-Registration Penalty
content:
A lien notation charge is added to a Title & Registration Services late-registration penalty: fifteen dollars (15.00) when the order records a lienholder and the state has returned the order for a lien information error, five dollars (5.00) when the order records a lienholder and no such return stands, and nothing when no lienholder is recorded.

The lienholder is the one recorded on the title order (Kestrel Auto Finance, an outside lender, or none). A lien information error return stands when the title order carries any state rejection entry with that reason.

| Lienholder recorded on the order | Lien information error return on the order | Lien notation charge |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Auto Finance or an outside lender | yes | 15.00 |
| Kestrel Auto Finance or an outside lender | no | 5.00 |
| none | either | nothing |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- An order recording an outside lender, never returned for a lien information error: 5.00 is added.
- An order recording Kestrel Auto Finance, returned once for a lien information error: 15.00 is added.
- An order with no lienholder: nothing is added.
